digest.component_or_area: create coordination and live outbound dispatch
propositions: Process restart during create must produce exactly one remote issue and one confirmed binding without duplicates

Create dispatch is governed by a single selector (create_route) with COORDINATOR_ROUTE as default and LEGACY_ROUTE as rollback, ensuring no dual-send across batch_dispatch, reroute_migrated_plans, and handle_create/create_one
Keyed recovery performs zero search; keyless recovery requires both three misses and 3600 seconds grace period
Links and children are held until create and confirmation are proven, while tombstones, filters, and read-only modes remain effective
Create route selector is applied uniformly across typed and batch dispatch paths to prevent parity drift between implementations
Coordinated core matches legacy contract: return create dict on confirmed, re-raise original exception on failure, emit BRIDGE_ALERT on landed-unconfirmed, defer on commit-unknown
